surface_display: Actual scans within 12m of sensor; 0.20m display voxels, +0.15 to +2.5m relative to scan-pose ground reference (sensor_z-0.75m).
green_display: Near-ground ray-free XY projection, shown only where a low measured return exists. Tile display height uses the lowest measured return near that scan ground reference; no terrain is invented in unmeasured cells. Observation visualization only, not traversability or terrain truth.
vehicle: Configured 0.6x0.6m footprint at recorded odometry; no physical contact simulation.
